settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceDesc: Customize the visual theme, application language, accent colors, and main layout.
settings.languageDesc: Select your preferred language or automatically detect your browser's regional locale.
settings.typographyTooltip: Use any font from Google Fonts. They are dynamically downloaded and applied in real time across the entire application.
settings.codeFontTooltip: Monospace font for code snippets, technical blocks, and markdown commands.
settings.codeFontPlaceholder: e.g. Google Sans Code, Roboto Mono...
settings.iconPackTooltip: Select the visual icon family that gives graphical identity to the app and your documents.
settings.emojiPackTooltip: Customize emoji rendering between the stylized Toss Face look and your native system emojis.
settings.systemEmojisDesc: Native default emojis based on your operating system (Apple, Windows, Android, Linux).
settings.tossfaceEmojisDesc: Expressive, modern emoji pack with Toss's stylized visual design.
settings.noteColorsDesc: Exclusively customize the color of headings and paragraphs inside your notes, for both light and dark mode.
settings.aiTooltip: Connect any AI provider: Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Groq, DeepSeek, Meta Llama, or local models (Ollama/LM Studio).
settings.aiEnvConfigNote: Configure your keys in the .env file to enable AI.
settings.editorDesc: Writing preferences, spellcheck, and document organization.
settings.focusModeDesc: Keeps the active paragraph highlighted while dimming the rest of the text and vertically centering the writing line on screen.
settings.spellcheckDesc: Displays native browser suggestions and red grammatical warning underlines while writing notes.
settings.defaultSortDesc: Defines how files are listed in the explorer and on the main dashboard.
settings.frontmatterDesc: Detects --- ... --- metadata headers and displays them in a collapsible visual bar.
settings.accountDesc: GitHub repository connection details and user session.
settings.serverManagedDesc: Connection managed via secure server environment variables.
settings.docsDesc: Webapp version information, official documentation links, and software licenses.
settings.versionDesc: Running on Next.js 15, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4. High-performance clean architecture.
settings.tpiDocsDesc: Official and complete documentation for Webapp.
settings.openSourceLicenseDesc: Free and open-source software for personal knowledge management.
settings.resetConfirmDesc: This action will restore the theme, Google Fonts typography, and layout options to their default values.
